form:FormGroup.label: Learning flow
form:FormGroup.helpText: The questions the stage asks the model, drawn as a flow: a step is a question of one kind — Chain, Split, Target, Configure or Admit — and the decision after it is the judging of a candidate. Solid connectors are transitions the flow declares; dashed ones are what happens by default: a pass goes down to the next step, a shortfall re-asks the step with its next candidate, spent candidates leave by the step's exit. P parks the session for a person; G gives the shape up and errors its streams. A step painted red names a problem; hover it to read which. Click a step to select it in the table.

form:FormGroup.label: Steps
form:FormGroup.helpText: The steps as a table, to add, edit, copy, delete and move; the chart follows. Chain comes first and takes no transition; the flow ends with a Configure step or the Admit step; a goto names a step, 'end', 'park' or 'give-up'.

form:FormGroup.label: As text
form:FormGroup.helpText: The same flow, one line per step, in the grammar import, export and the harness carry. Edit it and the chart and the table follow; a line that does not parse is reported and nothing changes until it does.

form:FormGroup.label: Question text
form:FormGroup.helpText: The words of each question, editable. The text shown is what this document uses: the built-in text, or this document's own where it has been changed. A variable written as a dollar sign and a name in braces is filled in when the question is put; each text names the variables it may use in the built-in. 'Use built-in' drops this document's change. Text is per kind of question: an edit to the configuration text is asked at every Configure step, parser and transform alike.
